en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large historic inn or guesthouse with a small tower and ornate roof. The building is in a semi-rural setting with a dirt road in front, trees around it, and hills or low mountains in the background. The façade shows timber-framed gables and several balconies and arched windows. The name of the establishment is painted prominently on the front and also appears on a hanging sign at the entrance garden terrace.
